headline: 《绿灯军团》称霸电影剧集双榜
headlineEn: Green Lantern Corps Dominates Both Film and TV Charts
summary: 电影《绿灯军团》领跑今日热榜，同IP剧集也登顶TV榜；《死神》影视双线受捧，新片《怒之杀》口碑发酵，剧集《侠探杰克》持续走高。
summaryEn: Movie 'Green Lantern Corps' leads today's charts, with its same-IP TV series topping the TV list; 'Death' is hot across both screens, while new film 'Rage Kill' gains buzz and 'Reacher' keeps climbing.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周累计4部新片待映。
industryHighlights.en: No new movies released today; 4 new movies are scheduled this week.
Upcoming 'The Last Sunrise' is generating anticipation.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》电影与剧集同IP联动，双双登顶榜单。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps movie and series cross-promote, both topping their respective charts.

industryHighlights.text: 《死神》同时出现在电影与剧集热榜，IP热度辐射多平台。
industryHighlights.en: Death appears on both film and TV hot lists, showing strong multi-platform appeal.

industryHighlights.text: 《玩具总动员5》跻身本周电影热度前列。
industryHighlights.en: Toy Story 5 ranks high among this week's hottest movies.
